verdict.rationale: Evals and CI are a fair axis for an agent orchestration framework, but the evidence shows only LangSmith tracing, debugging visualization and workflow comparison. Nothing documents built-in eval scoring or running evals in CI. Tracing is an adjacent observability feature, not quality scoring, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI
